documents.title: Safe Superintelligence raises $1B at $32B valuation
documents.text: Safe Superintelligence, the lab founded by former OpenAI chief scientist Ilya Sutskever, has closed its first external round: $1 billion in new funding at a $32 billion valuation, up from the near-$20 billion valuation in its earlier funding talks, according to people with knowledge of the deal. The round was led by Sequoia and Andreessen Horowitz. Sutskever leads Safe Superintelligence as chief executive and remains its only product owner. The company also confirmed two senior hires: Daniel Gross left Apple to join SSI as a partner overseeing talent, and Daniel Levy left OpenAI to join SSI as head of research. Sutskever founded Safe Superintelligence in March, and the lab says the new capital funds a multi-year, single-product research plan.
